_comment: Per-provenance-class effort priors. These are PLACEHOLDER PRIORS, deliberately coarse, to be replaced class-by-class with data: PRA/OIRA ICR burden-hour inventory (reginfo.gov) for form-filling hours; published permit fee schedules for dollars; permit-record timestamps for wait; market quotes for professional artifacts. Every number here should eventually carry a citation in 'basis'.

b.label: document already in household records
b.basis: prior: locate + copy an existing document (deed, utility bill, dated photo)

c.label: document requested from an institution
c.basis: prior: records request (permit history, assessor record); fee and wait vary by agency — EMPIRICAL

d.label: artifact the applicant must create
d.basis: prior: site plan / floor sketch / written description drawn by a layperson

e.label: artifact a paid professional must create
e.basis: prior: licensed contractor/engineer inspection or letter; market quotes needed — EMPIRICAL

f.label: government act (inspection, appointment)
f.basis: prior: scheduling + hosting an inspection + fee; permit-record timestamps are the validation data — EMPIRICAL

sensitivity_note: sensitive=true demands carry a psychological/legal-exposure cost with no scalar prior; report their count separately, never fold into hours.
